study_type: Scientific Data data descriptor: liver RNA-seq resource; no differential-expression analysis, DEG counts, or threshold reported (S2.5, S4.3).
primary_estimand: Within chronic T2 contusion SCI rats, effect of exercise on the liver transcriptome: SWIM vs sedentary CONT (tiny cage) and SWW vs CONT (tiny cage) in the SCI + Exercise set (S1.p2, S1.p3, S2.2.p1, S2.2.p4); and effect of enhanced in-cage activity: CONT + Large cage vs CONT + Tiny cage in the SCI + In-Cage Activity set (S1.p3, S2.2.p1, S2.2.p3).

sample_sets.SCI + Exercise (22 rats): No SCI 4, TX 4, CONT 4, CONT+SWIM 5, CONT+SWW 5; all tiny cages from 3 d post-injury (S2.2.p1, S2.2.p4)
sample_sets.SCI + In-Cage Activity (15 rats): No SCI + Standard 5, CONT + Tiny 5, CONT + Large 5 (S2.2.p1, S2.2.p3)

inclusion: All 37 samples deposited; paper suggests removing overlapping samples in PCA for future comparisons (S4.3) but specifies no exclusion rule.
planned_contrasts: CONT+SWIM vs CONT (SCI + Exercise set; S1.p3, S4.3.p2; paper reports no DEG count)
CONT+SWW vs CONT (SCI + Exercise set; S1.p3, S4.3.p2; paper reports no DEG count)
CONT+Large vs CONT+Tiny (SCI + In-Cage Activity set; S1.p3, S4.3.p1; paper reports no DEG count)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one liver per rat; rats doubly housed with same-group partners (S2.2.p1), cage IDs not deposited
paper_method: DESeq2 normalization only; no DE test reported

paper_threshold.source_locator: none: data descriptor reports no DE threshold

paper_results: Fig. 3 mean expression of liver-pathology genes in CONT vs No SCI; Fig. 4 Apoa1/Cyp1a2 tracks; no DE results.
